title: How a Drone Works in 60 Seconds 🚁⚡ #shorts
description:
A quadcopter has no rudder and no flaps. It flies only by changing the speed of its four propellers. Two spin clockwise and two counter-clockwise to cancel the twist, and a flight controller reads a gyroscope thousands of times per second to keep it level. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#drone #quadcopter #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A drone has *no rudder* and no flaps. It steers only by changing the speed of *four propellers*.

steps.label: Lift
steps.text: Each propeller pushes air *down*. When total thrust beats the *weight*, the drone rises.

steps.label: Opposite spin
steps.text: Two props spin *clockwise*, two *counter-clockwise*. Their twisting forces *cancel out*.

steps.label: Tilt
steps.text: Speed up the *back props*, and the drone tilts forward and *flies forward*.

steps.label: Turn
steps.text: Speed up one *diagonal pair*, and the leftover twist *spins the drone* in place.

steps.label: Brain
steps.text: A *flight controller* reads a *gyroscope* thousands of times per second and corrects every motor.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Four props, pure *speed control*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
